· RSI trajectory (37.3→45.3): Exiting oversold, entering neutral zone, strengthening upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0014→-0.0004): Improving in negative territory, no bearish reversal signal confirmed.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle band $0.09): Sideways near the middle band, with contracting volatility at 25.48% band width.

· Swing support ($0.08): Confirmed support based on 5-day/20-day lows and SMA100.
· Swing resistance ($0.09): Resistance zone based on SMA20/50 and Pivot PP; upside breakout expected to signal trend change.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (5-day high/low $0.08, 20-day high $0.10/low $0.08): Sideways pattern confirmed, no trend reversal signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.97): Normal level compared to 5-day average, moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): High probability of continued sideways movement between $0.08 support and $0.09 resistance; maintaining wait-and-see stance.
